notes.title: EE: The Body demo update 2.0
notes.notes:
Updated Extreme Evolution: Drive to Divinity free demo version ("The Body"):

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899859/2cfccf831054b5e6275184e7723d7376e76c0455.png


Pause menu rework: menu is now significantly more organized and easier to use. Forms can be sorted in the form menu now (by their age, name, or their stat attributes), the site menu is now rendered with more perspective, and the hypostasis menu displays the sum of your attributes (a sum of your collected form attributes stat values).
New desaturation effect: as you collect § in a given site, the saturation will fade in.  This effects all levels. This is also represented on the new site menu.
Visual motif improvements, such as new starry motif in areas such as Crunchy Bone (which is the updated name of Bone Artery), and new fire in the Outer Divine Atrium. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899859/952348d24494adb429b9082df688820d0c239dc1.png
Main menu reworked: fixed bug related to key rebinding, beatification, and now shows more preview information about the 3 save slots.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899859/1310fe904314b955a8563b7037489be34dd550de.png
New dynamic camera dampening & dynamic velocity system.
New UI fade out system.
Significant Performance improvements.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899859/bb60fa4b94b21c156875149ecbabc54cf64e16b2.png
New secret area (ft. new music), the Chair Factory.
Tweaks to various levels (both to add and remove pickups).{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899859/2c37144cb0dc06463bdfc1baf9d2e6ab4b598931.png
Two game endings are now accessible from The Body.
Balance changes to forms and sites.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899859/ad407e43832b9c82935cb6cfe451b84b6933386c.png


The full version of Extreme Evolution is still coming later in 2023! It's going to be quite a bit larger than The Body demo.

[previewyoutube=MsR9wfGhZGw;full][/previewyoutube]

Thanks for playing!
Sam Atlas
